title: Lazy Zesty Syrian Chicken Lasagna
description: A twist on traditional lasagna, this dish combines the flavors of Syria with a silky, citrusy sauce and a crispy puff pastry crust. Perfect for a lazy Sunday evening.
instructions: Cook the lasagna noodles according to the package instructions. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional minute, until fragrant.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned on all sides and cooked through, about 5-6 minutes.
Add the sun-dried tomatoes, lemon juice, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper to the skillet. Stir to combine.
To assemble the lasagna, spread a layer of the chicken mixture in the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Arrange 4 lasagna noodles on top of the chicken mixture.
Spread half of the ricotta cheese over the noodles, followed by half of the shredded mozzarella cheese.
Repeat the layers, starting with the chicken mixture, noodles, ricotta cheese, and mozzarella cheese.
Roll out the puff pastry sheet to a large rectangle. Place the pastry over the top of the lasagna, pressing the edges to seal.
Cut a few slits in the top of the pastry to allow steam to escape during baking.
Bake the lasagna in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, until the pastry is golden brown and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
